title: Are Non-English Papers Reviewed Fairly? Language-of-Study Bias in NLP Peer Reviews

bias_targets.methodology: Constructing a human-annotated dataset (LOBSTER) of peer review segments, benchmarking LLMs for three-way bias classification (negative, positive, no bias), and applying the best-performing model to a large corpus of NLP peer reviews to analyze bias prevalence and subcategories across different languages and paper contribution types.
